name: Asahi Kasei (AKM)
_note: AK4490 -3.5; AK4493 -1 to -3.5 depending on reference level; AK4499 -4.1; AK4499EX -3 depending on settings. "AKM and Cirrus Logic both have DSD Direct modes. AKM up to DSD512."
_dsd_reconverted_to_pcm: Direct DSD conversion up to DSD512, per the family note.
_replaced_a_device_record: Until 2026-11-24 a DEVICE record stood beside this family - devices/unknown/akm-generique - whose own source called it « Fallback entry, not a measured device. Chip-level facts only. » Its identity was brand "unknown", model "unknown", shared with two other records, and it asserted for every converter on this silicon the four fields _what_the_implementation_fixes says the silicon does NOT fix. It is gone, and nothing moved here: `family` was self-referential, `analog_filter` cannot live on a chip by this catalogue's own rule, and `correctable` is computed from dsd_direct on all 27 records. A chip's defaults belong in a chip family; they do not need a device to carry them.
_a_contradiction_it_was_hiding: That record said dsd_direct "to_be_measured" where this family says true - a disagreement between two levels of the same cascade, sitting unresolved. The record also contradicted ITS OWN quoted source, which reads « AKM supports direct DSD conversion ». Removing it resolves the disagreement towards the value that has evidence behind it, and that is the reason it is recorded here rather than silently dropped.
